Claims about semantic entities/dimensions/time/metric dependencies, data-cube observations and units, fanout-aware measures, approximate aggregates, and field-level lineage match the cited primary sources.

evidence: Checked the metric tuple M, governed snapshot R_s, eligible/success sets E and X, dimensions d, partitions x_j/n_j/r_j, distinct-set union, and implementation evaluator notation.
Chapter validation accepted all display-math delimiters and GitHub-compatible commands.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Symbols have stable meanings and undefined zero-denominator output is represented explicitly rather than as a numeric value.

Recomputed Exercise 2 pooled rate as 21/102 approximately 0.205882 and defined-rate macro-average as (0.5+0.2)/2=0.35.
numerical_recomputation.notes: All explicit components, rates, differences, overlaps, and zero-denominator outcomes reproduce.

evidence: Expanded sum_j(n_j/N)(x_j/n_j) to sum_j x_j/N, confirming denominator-weighted rate rollup.
Verified |A union B|=|A|+|B|-|A intersection B| and the disjointness condition for additive distinct counts.
Verified X subseteq E implies 0<=|X|<=|E| and a bounded count-based rate for positive denominator.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The algebra separates sufficient additive components from non-additive final values and states positive-denominator assumptions.

evidence: Reviewed zero eligibility, duplicate entities, identity merge/split, exact time boundaries, daylight-saving changes, late outcomes, partial periods, missing dimensions, and current versus as-of attributes.

Reviewed one-to-many fanout, stock-through-time, overlapping distinct sets, null/zero/suppressed states, refunds/negative measures, currency conversion, rounding, incompatible sketches, and small-cell disclosure.
Ten worked examples and five exercises exercise population, algebra, time, join, unit, freshness, version, and migration failures.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Boundary handling returns explicit undefined, provisional, estimated, suppressed, or unknown states instead of silently manufacturing ordinary values.

evidence: Checked stable name/owner/version, complete entity and published grain, inspectable eligibility/components, governed time/unit/null semantics, and contract/source snapshot lineage.
Checked success-subset bounds, additive slice reconciliation, fanout controls, distinct disjointness, currency/unit compatibility, and rate recomputation after aggregation.
Executable verification passed with additive components preserved for regrouping.
invariant_checking.notes: Each invariant names required grain, snapshot, contract version, unit, or approximation tolerance so coincidental totals cannot establish consistency.

evidence: Reviewed the weighted-rate theorem by direct substitution r_j=x_j/n_j and weights n_j/N.
Reviewed subset-rate bounds for finite count sets and positive denominator.
Reviewed extensional consistency condition and confirmed it is conditional on identical contract, parameters, authorization, normalized snapshot, and numeric rules.
proof_review.notes: The proofs establish aggregation/consistency properties under explicit assumptions and do not claim a metric is useful merely because it is deterministic.

evidence: Formal statements are labeled theorem, invariant, condition, or empirical boundary and have assumptions adjacent.
Approximate distinct/quantile behavior is labeled statistical estimation rather than exact proof.
No tool-specific documentation is presented as a universal semantic theorem.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: The chapter distinguishes algebraic proof, business policy, implementation contract, and empirical conformance evidence.

evidence: The Python example demonstrates one finite weighted-rollup case and does not claim universal data quality.
The empirical evidence boundary limits golden and dual-run tests to selected inputs and requests.
Approximation, freshness, revision, and status metadata are required wherever observed values are not exact/final/complete.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Empirical equality is framed as conformance evidence, not proof of business usefulness or safety for untested dimensions.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed measures, metrics, entities, dimensions, eligibility, base/output grain, aggregation algebra, time/windows, current/as-of attributes, units/currency, null/status, exact/approximate computation, semantic graphs, lineage, materialization, access and lifecycle. The contract model connects these without conflating formula and meaning.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed actionable workflows for definition ownership, golden fixtures, semantic compilation, safe joins, sufficient statistics, partial/final publication, API metadata, approximation, privacy suppression, dual-run reconciliation, alerting, breaking-version migration and deprecation. Exercises cover financial, product, support and platform use cases.

pedagogical_review.notes: The one-page review supplies the complete contract and central rollup result; exposition proceeds from decision and population through algebra, time, implementation and governance; notation supports the proofs; ten distinct examples expose common traps; and five exercises with complete answers require design, computation, reconciliation and migration.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed. References and local execution were checked on 2026-09-02, but organization-specific accounting/privacy policy, production-scale approximation error, decision usefulness, and future semantic-tool behavior remain outside this review.
